name: Lakkari Tar Pits
summary: In northern Un’Goro Crater, the Lakkari Tar Pits hold beasts fast and give rise to hostile tar elementals.

sections.title: A Grasping Trap
sections.body: South of Marshal’s Refuge, the Lakkari Tar Pits spread across northern Un’Goro Crater. Their black tar grips anyone who steps in and drags beasts and travelers into the mire. Bones of countless prehistoric creatures jut through the surface. Scavengers circle the pools for trapped prey, while tar beasts, lurkers, and creepers rise from the muck to attack those who enter.

faq.q: What happens if you step into the tar?
faq.answer: The tar grips anyone who wades in, slowing them to a crawl. That makes escape difficult when aggressive tar elementals patrol the pools.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Lakkari Tar Pits?
faq.answer: Tar beasts, tar creepers, tar lurkers, and tar lords inhabit the pits. Local scavengers circle the pools, searching for trapped prey.

faq.q: Where are the Lakkari Tar Pits located?
faq.answer: The Lakkari Tar Pits lie in northern Un’Goro Crater, in the basin directly below the cliffs of Marshal’s Refuge.

angles.text: As a hunter, keep your pets on firm ground near Lakkari. Creatures caught in the thick sludge make easy prey for tar lurkers.
